summary: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Bay Street, City Council approval of this report is required. The Bay Cloverhill Community Association (BCCA) and local Councillor requested staff to investigate the feasibility of installing traffic control signals at the intersection of Bay Street and Grenville Street. A traffic control signal evaluation and pedestrian crossover evaluation was undertaken and in both instances the warrant requirements were not met. Given this, the installation of traffic control signals at the intersection of Bay Street and Grenville Street is not recommended.
decided: City Council on June 26, 27, 28 and 29, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve the installation of traffic control signals at the intersection of Bay Street and Grenville Street.
